The paranoia aside, don't trust with technology you don't understand (any more than you have to). If you find yourself asking something like "Are messages private?" always start from a position of assuming you are not safe to share data that might harm you.

The single best way to be secure is to mix mediums. For example use a one time email account to exchange keys, but have the email contain no further information. The more blackboxed your security protocol is, the more improbable it is to be compromised.

Communicating in plain sight is also good... Use code and the comments section on a porn site, send the same message to many people (make the code look spammy).

Basically this, if you have something to hide, you need to adopt good operational security. Trusting a connected device with information that exposes you isn't smart. Doing so when you know you are being watched is borderline retarded.
